title: HK100 2027 official checkpoint table (image)
claims: The 2027 official checkpoint-table image has 11 rows from SP-East Dam at 10 km to Finish at 96 km; the cumulative distance at the finish is 96 km.
The table's per-stage gain and per-stage loss each total +5,142 m and −5,142 m, and the cumulative gain column reaches +5,142 m at the finish.

The table prints opening and closing clock times: East Dam 07:15/09:15, Sai Wan Pavilion 07:45/11:00, Pak Tam Au 08:30/13:45, Pak Sha O 09:00/16:00, Yung Shue O 09:30/18:30, Kei Ling Ha 10:30/21:15, Gilwell Camp 11:30/02:15, Beacon Hill 12:30/05:00, Shing Mun 13:30/07:15, Leadmine Pass 14:30/10:15, Finish 15:30/13:00.

The table labels its first row SP-East Dam, then numbers CP1 Sai Wan Pavilion through CP9 Leadmine Pass; from Sai Wan Pavilion onward these CP numbers are one lower than the course text's CP2 through CP10 numbering.
The table gives CP10 Leadmine Pass to Finish as 9 km (96 − 87), while the course text says 'just 10km to go' and the race card's 100 km minus 87 km gives 13 km.
The image is hosted on the organiser's own site under a 2026/11 upload path; this page links to the image, does not host, crop or redraw it, and uses only transcribed facts.
The course page's Food & Beverages section still says 'To be announced'; the checkpoint table lists no food or drink items.

verification.checkedVia: Official image downloaded and read visually
